summary: Plan clearer benefit messages, enrollment journeys and campaign measures. Explore this five-day benefits communication training course.
lede: Benefits communication helps HR, total rewards and employee communications professionals plan clear messages that support employees’ benefit decisions. The course develops practical skills in audience segmentation, plain-language eligibility explanations and enrollment journey design, with channel planning and measurement of reach, comprehension and action. Participants build a 12-month communications calendar and evaluation dashboard, using frameworks such as COM-B, EAST and Kirkpatrick to shape and assess campaigns.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who explain, administer or measure employee benefits and need to connect accurate information with clear employee action.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of employee benefits, HR operations or employee communications is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
